sections.content: - “100 Market Street, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94105 September 15, 2026 Smith Logistics LLC, 200 Harbor Way, Oakland, CA 94607 Re: Master Services Agreement dated March 1, 2025 Dear Sir or Madam: We represent Acme Corp in connection with the Master Services Agreement.” [2]

sections.title: What they demand
sections.content: - “Payment of $48,500 in overdue invoices within fourteen (14) days of the date of this letter.” [3]

citations.quote: Payment of $48,500 in overdue invoices within fourteen (14) days of the date of this letter.

sections.title: Deadlines
sections.content: - “Payment of $48,500 in overdue invoices within fourteen (14) days of the date of this letter.” [4]

citations.quote: Payment of $48,500 in overdue invoices within fourteen (14) days of the date of this letter.

sections.title: Each claim made
sections.content: - “Smith failed to deliver the Services on time in July and August 2026, which is a material breach.” [5]

citations.quote: Smith failed to deliver the Services on time in July and August 2026, which is a material breach.

sections.title: Threats and consequences
sections.content: - “If Smith does not comply by September 29, 2026, Acme will file suit and seek its attorneys' fees.” [6]

citations.quote: If Smith does not comply by September 29, 2026, Acme will file suit and seek its attorneys' fees.

sections.title: Amounts
sections.content: - “Under Acme Corp. v. Beta Transport, 512 F.3d 1201 (9th Cir. 2008), late performance of this kind entitles Acme to damages.” [7]
